from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json
import hashlib
import re
import subprocess

r=Path.cwd()
out=r/"reports/research/510300_macro_goal_continuation_audit_20261005_v1"
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
servicepath=out/"goal_service_blocked_result.json"
auditpath=out/"goal_no_progress_check_003.json"
finalpath=out/"goal_status_blocked_finalization_receipt.json"
def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def ref(p):
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args],cwd=r,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip()
if finalpath.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("目标受阻同步回执已存在，禁止重复覆盖")
service=json.loads(servicepath.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
assert service["goal"]["status"]=="blocked"
assert service["goal"]["threadId"]=="01a0e7c2-ae0c-7233-9b6e-e246c6647732"
assert sha(auditpath.read_bytes())=="2b7aed1a5161eb4fd2de17bbb45b8412a20861e7dc28e892f5b2c091d92a2285"
audit=json.loads(auditpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
assert audit["blocked_audit_pass"] and audit["root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns"]==3
paths=[r/"docs/PROJECT_STATE.md",r/"docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md",
       r/"config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json",r/"config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json"]
before={p:p.read_bytes() for p in paths}
texts={p:b.decode("utf-8-sig") for p,b in before.items()}
cfg=[json.loads(texts[p]) for p in paths[2:]]
assert all(x["goal_status"]=="active" and x["current_driver_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns"]==2 for x in cfg)
status=git("status","--short","--untracked-files=no")
note=(
"> 宏观目标续跑状态："+at+"：三轮连续事实核对均NO_PROGRESS，同等信息/完整支持缺口未解除，"
"当前已知候选无可执行合格金融实验，也无可核实的本宏观运行句柄可供等待。第三轮审查通过后目标服务已实际返回blocked，"
"当前线程目标受阻，夏普1.2及完整目标未达，不是complete或用户pause。自动续跑在此结束，0新采集/标签/模型/账户/现有源码。"
"E121缺2022-12原量影响15身份/519原池、E120156日期已用、DR007暂无访问的事实保持；全部旧冻结、NO_VIEW/UNSET及其他研究线各自权限不改。"
"解除需可核验的不同原因信息/真正新增样本与完整必要支持，不能改名/删未知/缩门救旧失败。"
"[三轮核对](../reports/research/510300_macro_goal_continuation_audit_20261005_v1/goal_no_progress_check_003.json)、"
"[服务实际返回](../reports/research/510300_macro_goal_continuation_audit_20261005_v1/goal_service_blocked_result.json)。"
)
changed={}
for p in paths[:2]:
    pattern=r"(?m)^> 宏观目标续跑状态：[^\r\n]*"
    oldnotes=re.findall(pattern,texts[p])
    assert len(oldnotes)==1
    t,n=re.subn(pattern,lambda _:note,texts[p])
    assert n==1 and t.replace(note,oldnotes[0],1)==texts[p],"研究事实或其他线被修改"
    changed[p]=t
config_changes={}
prior_status={}
for p,old in zip(paths[2:],cfg):
    new=json.loads(texts[p])
    old_audit=old["latest_goal_turn_audit"]
    new_audit=dict(old_audit)
    new_audit.update({
        "at":at,"previous_goal_turn_classification":old["current_driver_continuation_classification"],
        "previous_goal_turn_experiment_ids":[],"current_turn_experiment_ids":[],
        "classification":audit["classification"],"current_turn_is_research_progress":False,
        "root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":3,"blocked_threshold_met":True,"blocked_audit_pass":True,
        "audit_path":rel(auditpath),"revalidated_evidence":audit["source_evidence"],
        "goal_status":"blocked","goal_achieved":False,"goal_service_result":ref(servicepath),
        "goal_service_update":"RETURNED_BLOCKED","goal_status_finalization_receipt":rel(finalpath),
        "next_action_rule":"当前自动续跑结束；出现真实新信息/样本和必要完整支持后才可恢复资格研究，恢复不取消任何旧冻结拒绝。"})
    updates={
        "goal_status":"blocked","local_goal_work_status":"BLOCKED_HISTORICAL_ONLY_PENDING_NEW_INFORMATION_AND_COMPLETE_SUPPORT",
        "latest_goal_service_status":"blocked","latest_goal_service_status_observed_at":at,
        "current_driver_continuation_classification":"BLOCKED_AFTER_THREE_CONSECUTIVE_NO_PROGRESS_REVALIDATED_INFORMATION_SUPPORT_GAP",
        "current_driver_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":3,"consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":3,
        "latest_goal_continuation_audit":rel(auditpath),"latest_goal_turn_audit":new_audit,
        "goal_blocked_receipt":rel(servicepath),"goal_blocked_receipt_is_historical":False,
        "latest_goal_blocked_finalization_receipt":rel(finalpath),
        "driver_unblock_condition":"可核验的不同原因信息或真正新样本，并有当时可知/完整共同状态及必要训练支持；访问或新原资料更新须实际解除缺口，不保证策略达标，也不重开旧冻结失败。"}
    }
    prior_status[rel(p)]={k:old.get(k,"MISSING") for k in updates if k!="latest_goal_turn_audit"}
    new.update(updates)
    assert all(new[k]==v for k,v in old.items() if k not in updates),"更改了模型/风险/权限/旧结果"
    changed[p]=json.dumps(new,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n"
    config_changes[rel(p)]=list(updates)
for p in paths:
    if p.read_bytes()!=before[p]:
        raise RuntimeError("共享状态写前变化，停止覆盖："+rel(p))
writes=[]
for p in paths:
    if p.read_bytes()!=before[p]:
        raise RuntimeError("当前文件写前变化，停止覆盖："+rel(p))
    raw=changed[p].encode("utf-8")
    if before[p].startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
        raw=b"\xef\xbb\xbf"+raw
    p.write_bytes(raw)
    writes.append({"path":rel(p),"before_sha256":sha(before[p]),"after_sha256":sha(raw)})
assert git("status","--short","--untracked-files=no")==status
assert sha(auditpath.read_bytes())=="2b7aed1a5161eb4fd2de17bbb45b8412a20861e7dc28e892f5b2c091d92a2285"
final={
    "at":at,"goal_status":"blocked","goal_achieved":False,
    "goal_service_result":ref(servicepath),"blocked_audit":ref(auditpath),
    "audit_was_saved_before_service_update_and_its_active_state_is_historical":True,
    "root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":3,"blocked_threshold_met":True,
    "writes":writes,"configuration_status_only_updated_keys":config_changes,
    "prior_status_navigation_preserved":prior_status,
    "shared_research_facts_frozen_results_and_other_lines_unchanged":True,
    "preexisting_tracked_changes_unchanged":True,"existing_source_code_edits":0,
    "post_blocked_actions":"仅归档服务返回及同步当前目标事实；无研究/采集/金融运行",
    "full_objective_unchanged":service["goal"]["objective"],
    "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
    "orders_authorized":False,"automatic_goal_continuation_ended":True}
finalpath.write_text(json.dumps(final,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
lines={}
for p in paths[:2]:
    lines[rel(p)]=next(i+1 for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines()) if l.startswith("> 宏观目标续跑状态："))
print(json.dumps({"目标服务实际状态":"blocked","完整目标":"未实现","三轮连续无进展":3,
    "长期事实状态行":lines,"当前状态同步文件":len(writes),"原跟踪变动":len(status.splitlines()),
    "旧研究/其他线不变":True,"新研究/采集/模型/账户":0,"当前自动续跑":"已结束"},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
correction: 仅删除状态字典多余右括号，不改字段或研究条件。
